name: Huntarr-Lidarr
description:
DEPRECATED: Use Huntarr instead. 
        [br]
        Huntarr (Lidarr Edition) continually searches your Lidarr library for missing music or music that need quality upgrades. It automatically triggers searches for both missing music and music below your quality cutoff. It's designed to run continuously while being gentle on your indexers, helping you gradually complete your music collection with the best available quality.
requires: Requires a separate Lidarr v1 instance.

variables.name: Lidarr - API Key
variables.description: API key for your Lidarr instance

variables.name: Huntarr - Mode
variables.description: Which level to search for new releases at.

variables.name: Huntarr - Missing Items Per Cycle
variables.description: Maximum missing items to process per cycle. Set to 0 to disable.

variables.name: Huntarr - Upgrade Albums Per Cycle
variables.description: Maximum upgrade albums to process per cycle. Set to 0 to disable.

variables.name: Huntarr - Use Random Selection
variables.description: Use random selection for processing if enabled, or sequential if disabled.

variables.name: Huntarr - Minimum Queue Size
variables.description: Minimum number of items in the download queue before starting a hunt. Set to -1 to disable.

variables.name: Lidarr - API Timeout
variables.description: Timeout for API requests in seconds.

variables.name: Huntarr - Sleep Duration
variables.description: Duration, in seconds, to wait between cycles.

variables.name: Huntarr - Reset Interval
variables.description: Interval, in hours, after which to reset the processed state files. Set to 0 to disable.

variables.name: Debug Mode
variables.description: Enable debug mode for detailed logging.

variables.name: Command Status - Wait Time
variables.description: Delay in seconds between checking for command status

variables.name: Command Status - Max Attempts
variables.description: Maximum number of attempts to check for command status
